verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions idempotency keys, request IDs, or safe retry semantics for outbound API requests. The only deduplication evidence covers inbound webhook events: each has a stable id so receivers can ignore retries. That is a different capability from making API calls idempotent to prevent duplicate charges.

support.subject: As a developer, I can safely retry any API request using idempotency keys so network failures never create duplicate charges
